name: harden-toolchain-failure-paths
title: Harden toolchain failure paths
description: Bound two unbounded failure paths in the vendored automation scripts. Housekeeping's review-thread GraphQL pagination gains a page cap or a repeated-endCursor break so a misbehaving cursor skips auto-merge instead of spinning forever, and the work loop's atomic_write_json adopts the descriptor-ownership handoff so except-cleanup cannot close a descriptor fdopen already owns.
creator: sdelmas
